questions.text: Which customers are at risk of moving to a competitor, and why?
questions.reference: Meridian Foods (Pune): no filter cartridges, evaluating AquaPure, 40-unit order on hold. Kaveri Distributors (Chennai): stock and cartridge shortage, AquaPure offering better margins. TechHome Solutions (Bengaluru): Halo pairing failures, trialling LumaSmart, orders paused.

questions.text: Do the store visit reports or customer calls explain any dip in the sales data?
questions.reference: Yes: Cascade Water Purifier sales in the South fell in August (136 units in July to 35 in August) because South stores (Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad) were out of stock; the commentary blames missed supplier shipments. Sales recovered in September (150). Customers Kaveri and Meridian also cite cartridge/stock shortages.

questions.text: Which product earned the most net revenue in H1, and how much?
Which products missed their H1 unit target?
questions.reference: Missed: Cascade Water Purifier (3,246 vs target 3,700), Ember Room Heater (1,145 vs target 1,400), Flux Mixer Grinder (5,109 vs target 5,400), Halo Smart Bulb (4,890 vs target 6,400).

questions.text: Summarise how the Halo Smart Bulb has done since launch.
questions.reference: Launched June 2026 with a 15% introductory discount; units grew every month (June 501; July 1,078; August 1,513; September 1,798); app pairing problems reported by customers and stores; app fix in progress.
